trace.rule: up or down only if the corrected p < 0.05 and the change is at least 2-fold; otherwise no call
checked: No-template controls on the plates of MYC and its control genes: no study well used here sits within their window.
Whole-sample efficiency: no sample used here amplifies unusually poorly.
With fewer than three control genes, a control-gene well cannot be checked against the others.
cannot_show: A single target well that is off cannot be told apart from biology without technical replicates.
A fault shared by every sample of one group looks like biology (a design question).
A wrong sample in the tube, RNA integrity, RT replicates and no-RT controls leave no footprint here unless annotated.
